data.turoyo: Mḥele b dukṯo ḥreto, mhamhamle. Omər: "Harke yo i mʕarṯo, mnayšalle."
data.translation: endlich schlug er an eine Stelle, wo Wiederhall kam. »Hier ist die Höle«, sagte er und machte ein Zeichen an der Stelle.

rationale: New Preterit box: affirmative resounding at another tested place; explains the cave-detection context.

summary: All three occurrences fit I.1 dröhnen (Hohlraum). Keep the glossary’s stem I label for this quadriliteral; do not relabel it Q.
The existing mhamhamle base is confirmed in both negative and affirmative Preterit events, while the preceding relative d-mhamhəm gives a general diagnostic property in Infectum.

The echoing location is the sound-bearer, and -le does not establish a separate human agent or transitive cause. Two tested locations can be described with an implicit singular/impersonal event predicate.
Confirm singular/impersonal agreement of mhamhamle after b tarte dəkoṯo in PrS 41/29.
Verify correspondence of PrS 41/29 with inherited prs 113/27 before changing any existing citation.

rationale: The German verb for resounding or echoing is widerhallen, written without ie in wider-.

summary: Restore the missing h in Höhle
rationale: The German noun for a cave is Höhle; Höle omits h.
